Cry''' is a [[warcry]] [[skill]] that [[taunt]]s nearby enemies and grants a buff to you and nearby allies. The buff grants additional elemental [[resistances]] and maximum elemental resistances based on the [[Enemy power|power of nearby enemies]]. It also causes your next [[strike]] attacks to exert, targeting two additional enemies. ==Skill functions and interactions== '''Power''': {{c|help|Normal Monsters have 1 Power, Magic Monsters 2, Rare Monsters 10, Unique Monsters 20, and Players 5}} '''Multistrike and Exerted attacks''': {{Il|Multistrike Support}} supported skills cannot be exerted, although skills that inherently hit multiple times, like {{Il|Double Strike}}, consume one exerted attack per use of the skill. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression | c1_abbr = Warcry
Speed | c1_header = x% increased Warcry Speed | c1_pattern_extract = (%d+)%% increased Warcry Speed | c1_pattern_value = %s%% }} {{Item acquisition}} {{Skill threshold jewel list|stat_id=jewel_warcry}} {{Skill enchantment modifier list}} {{Alternate skill effect list|query= items.class_id="Microtransaction" AND cosmetic_items.cosmetic_type LIKE "Skill Gem Effect" AND ( items.name LIKE "%warcry%" OR items.description LIKE "%warcry%" ) }} ==Version history== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.25.0| * No longer grants a buff which gives you bonus armour and melee range. Instead, the user and nearby allies gain a buff that grants elemental resistances. The buff grants +5% to all Elemental Resistances per 5 power and +1% to all Maximum Elemental Resistance per 10 power, and can count a maximum of 30 power. Now has a base duration of 2.5 seconds at gem level 1 (previously 4), scaling up to 3.4 seconds at gem level 20 (previously 4.9). }} {{Version history table row|3.23.0| * Quality now provides 0-40% increased Cooldown Recovery Rate (previously 0-20%). }} {{Version history table row|3.21.0| * Quality on Ancestral Cry now provides 0-20% increased Cooldown Recovery Rate (previously 0-10%). }} {{Version history table row|3.12.2| * Fixed a bug where repeatedly using '''Ancestral Cry''' could give your character ever-increasing [[Armour]]. }} {{Version history table row|3.11.0| * '''Ancestral Cry''' has been added to the game. }} {{Version history table end}} ==References== {{reflist}} {{Navbox Skills}}
